entries.title: Tag your tasks with your project's own tags
entries.body: A project's page in Settings → Projects now has Tags: give each tag a name, such as bug, feature or idea, and a description of which tasks belong under it. A task's Info tab shows its tags, and Edit tags ticks them on or off; your first mate can tag tasks and change a project's tags when you ask. Removing a tag takes it off every task after one question that says how many.

picture.alt: A task's Info tab with its Tags row showing bug, and the Edit tags menu open with bug ticked on and feature and idea off, each under its description
